en: Illustrated seascape of an early 20th‑century warship under steam in rough green water. The ship is painted white with yellow funnels and superstructure, and flies two Japanese naval flags: a white flag with a red disc at the stern and the Rising Sun naval ensign with rays at the main mast. Dark smoke pours from the funnels into a cloudy sky. There is a small artist's signature at the lower left, but no visible caption or printed text on the image side.
